name: Go To Market Strategy
description: Produces a completed go-to-market strategy document using STP (Segmentation, Targeting, Positioning) and AIDA frameworks covering target segment, channels, messaging, pricing, and launch sequence. Use when the user asks to create a GTM strategy, plan a product launch, define market entry approach, or structure a launch plan for a new product or feature. Do NOT use for ongoing marketing strategy (use marketing-strategy), brand positioning only (use brand-positioning), or competitive landscape analysis (use competitive-analysis).
